steps.title: Cream the eggs
steps.body: Cream together in bowl: **3 eggs**, **1 cup oil** and **2 cups sugar**.

steps.title: Add the rest
steps.body: Add and mix in: **2 cups zucchini** (peeled and grated), **3 cups sifted flour**, **¼ tsp salt**, **¼ tsp baking soda**, **2 tsp cinnamon**, **½ tsp cloves**, **½ tsp nutmeg**, **½ tsp baking powder** and optional **1 cup nuts**.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake in sprayed pans at 350°F for approximately 1 hour.
